fields.name: PgParameterCollectionExtensions typed PostgreSQL parameter library
fields.contract: PgParameterCollectionExtensions extends a DbParameterCollection with the AddPg*Parameter family. For a Query contract, every member appends exactly one parameter for its named PostgreSQL type and returns the same collection. The family varies by PostgreSQL type (Varchar, Char, Text; Bigint, Integer, Smallint, InternalChar, Boolean, Numeric, Money, Double, Real; Timestamp, TimestampTz, Date, Time, Interval, TimeTz; Array, Bytea, Hstore, Uuid), direction (Input or Output), nullable/reference value support, and only where applicable size, precision, scale, or an Array element type.
